Here are consistently strong **online beauty stores that serve the GCC** (UAE, Saudi, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman). “Best” depends on what you buy (prestige makeup vs. pharmacy skincare vs. fragrance vs. K‑beauty), so I’m grouping them by what they’re best at.

## Best for prestige makeup + exclusives
- **Sephora Middle East** — best all-around for prestige brands, shade ranges, gifts/sets, and new launches. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sephora?utm_source=openai))  
- **Faces** — strong prestige assortment in the Gulf (especially fragrance + gifting) and a big retail footprint backing online service. ([20087041.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net](https://20087041.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/20087041/2024%20Middle%20East%20Beauty%20Market%20Report/%28Updated%29%20BM%20BWME%20Middle%20East%20Report%202024.pdf?utm_source=openai))

## Best “beauty + fashion” e‑commerce (often great deals)
- **Namshi** — strong beauty section with frequent promos alongside fashion (good if you like bundling orders). ([arabnews.com](https://www.arabnews.com/sites/default/files/pdf/46349/files/assets/common/downloads/publication.pdf?uni=c6819cfcd039296670b4d1d87c43b8fd&utm_source=openai))  
- **Ounass** — luxury positioning (beauty + fashion) with premium service expectations. ([arabnews.com](https://www.arabnews.com/sites/default/files/pdf/46349/files/assets/common/downloads/publication.pdf?uni=c6819cfcd039296670b4d1d87c43b8fd&utm_source=openai))

## Best for pharmacy / drugstore beauty (fast restocks, everyday staples)
- **Watsons (GCC / UAE site shown)** — wide everyday beauty + personal care selection, with presence across multiple GCC countries. ([watsons.ae](https://www.watsons.ae/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Boots UAE** — solid for pharmacy-beauty, derm/skincare staples, and seasonal promotions. ([ae.boots.com](https://ae.boots.com/en/?utm_source=openai))

## Best KSA-first beauty app/store
- **Nice One (Saudi)** — very popular in KSA with broad catalog across makeup, perfume, skincare, tools, etc. ([niceonesa.com](https://niceonesa.com/en?utm_source=openai))

## Best general marketplaces (useful, but be selective about sellers)
- **Noon** — huge selection; best if you stick to official stores/fulfilled-by options for authenticity. ([beautyworld-middle-east.ae.messefrankfurt.com](https://beautyworld-middle-east.ae.messefrankfurt.com/content/dam/messefrankfurt-dubai/beautyworld-middle-east/2024/beautymatter/beautymatter-2024-middle-east-beauty-market-report.pdf?utm_source=openai))  
- **Amazon (GCC)** — similarly convenient; just be careful with third‑party sellers for fragrance/skincare.

## Best niche option (if you’re specifically into Korean skincare)
- **EmartGCC (Kuwait-based)** — focused on “original Korean skincare” positioning and K‑beauty brands. ([emartgcc.com](https://emartgcc.com/pages/about-us?utm_source=openai))

If you tell me **which GCC country you’re ordering to** and what you buy most (fragrance / makeup / derm skincare / K‑beauty / haircare), I can narrow this to the best 3–5 for your needs and flag which ones are typically best for **authenticity, price, or fastest delivery**.
